newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Eighteen injured by blast in Pakistani town.
newsitem.headline: Eighteen injured by blast in Pakistani town.

text.p: A blast in the Pakistani town of Gujranwala in the central province of Punjab injured 18 people on Wednesday, doctors and ambulance workers said.
They said the blast occurred at a main market at about 12.15 p.m. (0715 GMT) and injured at least 18 people, two of them seriously.
It was not immediately known what caused the explosion. A doctor at the Gujranwala's government Civil Hospital quoted witnesses as saying it appeared to be a bomb blast.
